Please, I have a family.''"
"''One more word, I take it all.|Padu Cherd and Groff Ditcher|audio=Cherd-Ditcher-OBK1.flac|}} '''Groff Ditcher''' was a brutish [[human]] who worked as the [[foreman]] of [[Tibidon Station]], a [[Tibidon sand whale|sand whaling]] station on his [[homeworld]], [[Tatooine]]. In [[9 BBY]], he shoved his employee [[Padu Cherd]] and threatened to pay him nothing when Cherd complained at only receiving half pay. Fellow laborer [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] scowled at Ditcher but said nothing, causing the foreman to scoff. Ditcher later pushed to the front of a line for [[water]] in [[Anchorhead]] but had the water thrown from his hand by the former [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander]]. ==Biography== ===Bullying boss=== {{Quote|Something you want to say?|Groff Ditcher to Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=Ditcher-Something-OBK1.flac|}} [[File:CherdPunchOut-KenobiPartI.png|thumb|right|300px|Groff Ditcher was foreman of Tibidon Station.]] Groff Ditcher was a brutish [[human]] who worked as [[foreman]] of [[Tibidon Station]], a sand whaling station established to harvest [[Foodstuff|meat]] from the carcass of a large [[tibidon sand whale]]{{SW|url=obi-wan-kenobi-part-i-trivia-gallery|text=Part I Trivia Gallery | Obi-Wan Kenobi}} in the [[desert]]s of Ditcher's [[homeworld]], [[Tatooine]]. Following one shift at the site in [[9 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Kenobi|Part I}} and {{Kenobi|Part VI}} to [[9 BBY]]. Ditcher stood by a [[GNK-series power droid]] with a [[payment dispenser]] attached to its head as the laborers used their [[punch disc]]s to collect their [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for the [[Standard day|day]]. After collecting his payment, laborer [[Padu Cherd]] complained that it was only half and pleaded with Ditcher for the rest, but the foreman shoved Cherd away and warned that he would pay him nothing at all if he spoke another word. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the last laborer in the line, then scowled at Ditcher as he approached, but when the foreman asked if Kenobi had anything to say, the laborer silently took his payment and moved on to board the transport back to the town of [[Anchorhead]]. Ditcher scoffed and then spoke to other workers at the site in an [[alien]] [[language]]. ===Encounter with an Inquisitor=== {{Quote|Something you wanna say?''"
"''I have something to say.''"
"''Wait your turn. You can have what's left when I'm done.|Groff Ditcher addresses Dardin Shull, before being answered by Reva|{{Kenobi|Part VI}}}} [[File:DitcherMeetsReva-OWKpVI.png|thumb|left|300px|Reva Sevander knocks the water cup from Ditcher's hand.]] Later that [[Standard year|year]], Ditcher was in Anchorhead, where he pushed to the front of a line for [[water]] being served by the cart vendor [[Dardin Shull]] from a [[portable vaporator]].{{Kenobi|Part VI}} {{AD|Disney+}} Pushing the old man at the front of the queue out of the way, Ditcher took a filled cup from Shull's hands as the vendor frowned at him. The foreman questioned if Shull had something to say, but the former [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander]], who stood in the line behind him, answered him instead. Ditcher told her to wait her turn, but using [[the Force]] she threw the water from his hand and glared at him as he silently backed away. She then questioned Shull on the whereabouts of the [[moisture farmer]] [[Owen Lars]]. ==Personality and traits== [[File:GroffDitcher-KenobiPartI.png|thumb|230px|right|Ditcher was a bully who tried to intimidate anyone who opposed him.]] {{Quote|Keep moving.|Ditcher sends Padu Cherd away after threatening him|audio=Ditcher-Moving-OBK1.flac|}} Groff Ditcher was a brutish man and a bully, believing he was superior to everyone around him. He was quick to use violence to keep his employees in line and pushed and threatened Padu Cherd when the laborer pleaded for his family's sake and tried to intimidate Kenobi, Shull, and Reva, although he backed away after seeing the latter use the Force. Ditcher had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and green [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Ditcher wore a light brown [[Clothing|shirt]], a brown [[belt]] over a black apron, brown pants, brown [[glove]]s, and brown [[boot]]s. He carried a [[knife]] in a sheaf on his belt that he used for butchering.''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' When he encountered Sevander in Anchorhead, he was also wearing a gray [[Jacket|coat]]. ==Behind the scenes== Groff Ditcher was portrayed by [[Heath McGough]] in the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' television series, where he first appeared in the [[Part I|first episode]], which aired on [[May 27]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}} The Tibidon Station scenes were the first filmed for the series''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]'' and were captured using the technology known as "the Volume," while the scenes McGough filmed for the sixth episode were captured on location in a desert.{{WebCite|url=https://wrestlingjunkies.wixsite.com/wrestlingjunkies/heath-mcgough-interview|text=Heath McGough Interview - Between Obi Wan Kenobi , Miracle Workersand the Star Wars Family|author=Lorenz, Bernd|date=2022-10-15|work=The Entertainment Junkie|archivedate=20231103091515}} Ditcher's name is not spoken in either episode but appears in the credits. ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part I}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 1|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 1]] *{{Kenobi|Part VI}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 6|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 6]] ==Sources== *''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]'' {{Video}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Groff Ditcher|soundcat=Audio files of Groff Ditcher}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Groff Ditcher |es=Groff Ditcher |fr=Groff Ditcher |ja=グロフ・ディッチャー |ka=გროფ დიჩერი |pl=Groff Ditcher |pt=Groff Ditcher }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ditcher, Groff}} [[Category:Foremans]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Tatooinians]]
